Copy/paste note: GLN Math Typer uses standard Unicode math characters and plain-text templates, so copied text works in Google Docs, Classroom, Gmail, Slides, Word, messages, and most websites. Some advanced layouts—especially stacked fractions, professional matrices, and fully typeset integrals— require the destination app's equation editor. This tool keeps the copied version broadly compatible.
